install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-6be75f4ecc5c2094e0c1，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-desktop-shortcut 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6be75f4ecc5c2094e0c1.html
posts.en:
dsh-desktop-shortcut is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6be75f4ecc5c2094e0c1.html
